recommendations.title: Fix the broken relations first
recommendations.found: 49 broken relation(s) in 9 tenant(s): Major fault F3083 (16); Critical fault F0467 (EPG deployment on path failed) (9); Contract service graph not instantiated (9); BD VRF missing-target (4); EPG chain broken (BD has no VRF) (4); EPG domain missing-target (4)
recommendations.action: Create the missing targets (VRF, domain, L3Out, device context) or remove the stale relations; missing-target objects never deploy and APIC may silently fall back to tn-common defaults.

recommendations.title: Contract design: no permit-any, keep vzAny/preferred groups deliberate
recommendations.found: Permit-any filter: 4 (e.g. tn-PROVA1/brc-Temp_PtP_vzany, tn-TN-POC-LN/brc-CON-POC-LEGACY); vzAny contract: 3 (e.g. tn-ROR/ctx-ROR_VRF, tn-TN-DEDUP-LAB/ctx-VRF-LAB)
recommendations.action: Use specific filters (protocol + destination port, stateful where possible) instead of common/default or 'ip any'; reserve vzAny for shared services (DNS/NTP/ICMP) with narrow filters; keep every VRF enforced; avoid preferred groups except for migrations.

recommendations.title: Every contract needs both a provider and a consumer; remove dead/duplicate contracts
recommendations.found: Contract provided, never consumed: 4 (e.g. tn-ROR/brc-ALLOW_ICMP_Ct, tn-ROR/brc-WEB_TO_OUTSIDE); Contract consumed, never provided: 4 (e.g. tn-TN-DEDUP-LAB/brc-C-L3OUT-MGMT, tn-common/brc-ct-DNS-SHARED); Contract unused: 4 (e.g. tn-DEV/brc-SSH-CONTRACT, tn-hacki-tn-a/brc-mgmt); EPG isolated (no contracts): 1053 (e.g. tn-PROVA1/ap-AP-BCC-222/epg-EPG_V3920_10.193.250.16_28, tn-T1/ap-AP1/epg-EPG1); External EPG without contracts: 4 (e.g. tn-ACME/out-DEVELOPMENT-VRF_FIREWALL-L3.OUT/instP-DEVELOPMENT-VRF_FIREWALL-XEPG, tn-ACME/out-ENGINEERING-VRF_FIREWALL-L3.OUT/instP-ENGINEERING-VRF_FIREWALL-XEPG); Duplicate contract: 3 (e.g. tn-TN-DEDUP-LAB/brc-C-APP-DB-FW, tn-TN-DEDUP-LAB/brc-C-MONITORING-OLD)
recommendations.action: Model each flow as provider (server side) + consumer (client side) in NaC; delete unused and duplicate contracts (e.g. *-OLD) so the policy matches the intent.

recommendations.title: Match contract scope to real usage
recommendations.action: Use 'context' by default, 'tenant'/'global' only for inter-VRF/tenant flows (with shared subnets).

recommendations.title: Make BD settings match their role (L2 vs L3)
recommendations.found: L3 BD without subnet: 4 (e.g. tn-LAB/BD-BD-LAB, tn-Learning/BD-BD-TEST); L3 BD flooding: 929 (e.g. tn-DEV/BD-10.1.200.0_24, tn-DEV/BD-10.1.201.0_24)
recommendations.action: L3 BD: unicast routing + gateway subnet, hardware proxy, ARP flooding off, limit IP learning to subnet. L2 BD: unicast routing off, ARP flooding on, unknown unicast flood, no subnets.

recommendations.title: Clean up unused objects
recommendations.found: Tenant empty: 1; VRF unused: 6; BD unused: 7; AP without EPGs: 3; Filter unused: 7; L3Out without external EPG: 10
recommendations.action: Delete leftovers or bring them under NaC; unused objects hide real intent and drift.

recommendations.title: Add descriptions
recommendations.found: 2238 of 2324 VRF/BD/AP/EPG/contract/filter/L3Out objects have no description.
recommendations.action: Set descr on every object (NaC: description:) - owner, purpose, ticket/change ID.

recommendations.title: Tag ownership (annotations) for NaC
recommendations.found: 386 of 2324 objects have no annotation; in use: 'orchestrator:ansible' x1878, 'orchestrator:terraform' x58, 'epg1' x1, 'epg-2' x1.
recommendations.action: Push everything through NaC/Terraform so objects carry 'orchestrator:terraform' (or a tag such as nac:owner=<team>); objects without it are hand-made and drift-prone.

recommendations.title: Adopt one naming convention
recommendations.found: name styles in use: UPPER_SNAKE 2221, Mixed 67, lower 36; 8 generic/VLAN/IP-style names (e.g. tn-DEV/BD-10.1.200.0_24, tn-DEV/BD-10.1.201.0_24, tn-DEV/BD-10.1.202.0_24, tn-DEV/ap-VLANS/epg-VLAN200, tn-DEV/ap-VLANS/epg-VLAN201).
recommendations.action: e.g. <app>_VRF, <app>_<tier>_BD, <app>_AP, <tier>_EPG, <consumer>-to-<provider>_CON, <proto>-<port>_FLT; enforce it in the NaC schema/linting.

recommendations.title: Bind EPGs to a domain
recommendations.action: Every EPG that should carry endpoints needs a physical/VMM domain whose VLAN pool covers the encap.
